description: This file defines the ElasticSearchIndexer class responsible for managing Elasticsearch indices, including creation, deletion, indexing modules and beans, and handling metadata within the SuiteCRM system. It integrates with Elasticsearch client and SuiteCRM's indexing framework.

classes.name: ElasticSearchIndexer
classes.description: Class responsible for managing Elasticsearch indices, including creation, deletion, indexing modules and beans, and handling metadata within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs full or differential indexing of modules into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: removeIndex
methods.description: Deletes a specific Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates a new Elasticsearch index with optional settings.

methods.name: indexModule
methods.description: Indexes all beans of a specific module into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: buildWhereClause
methods.description: Builds the query conditions for differential indexing based on last index time.

methods.name: indexBeans
methods.description: Indexes a batch of beans into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: removeAllIndices
methods.description: Deletes all Elasticsearch indices.

methods.name: indexBean
methods.description: Indexes a single bean into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Removes a single bean from Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: removeBeans
methods.description: Removes multiple beans from Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks connectivity with Elasticsearch server.

methods.name: putMeta
methods.description: Stores metadata for an index.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an index.

methods.name: getBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the current batch size for indexing.

methods.name: setBatchSize
methods.description: Sets the batch size for indexing.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the current index name.

methods.name: setIndex
methods.description: Sets the index name.

methods.name: indexBatch
methods.description: Creates a batch request for Elasticsearch indexing.

methods.name: differentialIndexing
methods.description: Checks if differential indexing is enabled and last run timestamp is available.

methods.name: makeIndexParamsBodyFromBean
methods.description: Creates Elasticsearch document body from a SugarBean.

methods.name: sendBatch
methods.description: Sends a batch request to Elasticsearch and handles errors.

methods.name: makeIndexParamsFromBean
methods.description: Generates index parameters for a bean.

methods.name: makeParamsHeaderFromBean
methods.description: Generates header parameters for a bean.

methods.name: getModuleLastIndexed
methods.description: Retrieves last index time for a module from metadata.

methods.name: repairElasticsearchIndex
methods.description: Static method to repair or rebuild Elasticsearch index, optionally with specific documentifier.
